title: Wet Type
description: The word monsoon printed huge in wet blue ink on white. Your pointer is a squeegee: drag it through the letters and they smear along your stroke in combed streaks, thick and solid when slow, thin and dry when fast, then slowly pull themselves back into type.
intent: The drag is the type: no brush layer at all, just a decaying flow field that drags the letterforms themselves, combed by the blade’s teeth and dithered where the ink runs thin.

sources.name: Custom-Shaped Cursor Trail by Bautista Berto (Codrops, 2026)
sources.what: MIT. The grid trail field (flow in R/G, speed in B, exponential decay), the patterned hatch stamp with a radial falloff envelope, the 9-tap blur of the field and the UV warp of the type by flow; ported to a WebGL 2 pass with the stripes turned to run along the stroke like squeegee teeth, a directional smear and Bayer dither for dry ink.
